scope.partition: By physical leaf: f83 joint discovery, f75 and f104 additional applications. These are complete nominated units, not whole-leaf semantic coverage.
scope.RF_scope: External same-locus complete-line scope only; no imputed native paragraph flags.

criteria.requirement: Freeze one global dictionary for joint discovery and transfer. Every exact whole retains one semantic function/signature, or a finite explicitly listed overload set with deterministic source-accessible selection guards. Record all derived cuts, whole residual priority, fallback/default priority and any ambiguity. Position alone does not authorize an unstated value switch. Different referents or fresh instances are allowed only through the same declared function.

Retain unchanged existing GDT605 ordered formal units and permitted alternative cuts wherever an exact cached application exists. Retain whole and entry-context residuals; do not turn BPE pieces into identified morphemes. A proposed semantic split outside the exact cache is separately declared/priced, not a newly established formal parse. GDT062 is register-conditioned formal rendering, not segmentation or semantic grammar. No new training/parser, universal wrapper deletion, aiin prefix rule, or reader normalization.

For every packet source group preserve unique source_group_id, native reader and ID-reader consistency, page/locus/unit/position/native order, raw group, raw line/spacing/separators/entities, uncertainty flags, paragraph flags, kind and every supplied native annotation. Retain all readers, absent pairs and gaps. Do not replace source bytes with cleaned projections. Additional parsed terminals link back to the unchanged source group; concatenation or split hypotheses never overwrite its boundary.

Declare all used semantic types and field/register schemas. Keep kinds, individuals, descriptions, predicates, asserted facts, goals, plans and physical executions distinct. Nominal mention does not allocate an individual, a predicate does not assert itself, a goal does not execute, and a proposed substitution does not remove an installed object without a priced explicit rule. Every kind-to-instance lift, object-to-procedure coercion, assertion conversion and fresh-ID allocator must be declared.

The old-role expression, proposed material expression and choice/reference constructor require actual source-ID-bound producers. Record exact operands, typed resolver input/output, producer before/after states, output IDs and dependencies. An initial selected material, desired source answer or clause-identity lookup cannot count as written production. Charge any initial participant and external/reference bridge; distinguish its provenance from produced output.

Specify target-role resolution and exclude pending proposed descriptions from prior completed-role lookup only if that is a declared rule. Record all candidates and finite disambiguation/tie/default policies. Separately specify branch guard, selection function and optional-plan creation. INSTEAD_OF or ALSO alone does not entail optionality. A guardless optional alternative remains a Choice/AlternativeSet or branched result until a separately declared selector/consumer chooses; report all allowed branches rather than pretending one concrete instance was selected by the manuscript.

Every nominated later consumer must consume the actual computed output ID (or an explicitly derived result/reference to it), with source IDs, typed arguments and producer-to-consumer dependency path. Ambient current-role equality or a nominally identical initial object is insufficient. Show what output/argument changes under the authored branch and which later computed fact/plan changes. Repeated assertion/readout IDs do not become independent executions or observations.

Freeze field/statement/operation scope and each reset/import policy; preserve native paragraph starts/ends and line transitions. No paragraph reset is inferred solely from layout or a DY-like suffix. ZL/IT boundary differences remain distinct. RF has no native paragraph flags here: same-locus complete lines are external-scope alternatives, not RF paragraphs. Earlier output may cross a scope boundary only through an explicitly paid import/reference rule. Retain pending-state lifetime and discharge semantics.

For each unit/reader report actual first source-ID/raw/position where an unknown could provide arguments/control scope, required type/register is missing, overload cannot select, or pending construct fails. Freeze dependent downstream derivation; preserve later known annotations as BLOCKED, not another successful restart. A separately declared and priced neutral interpretation is a C0 value, not a waiver of an unknown. Source-incomplete, semantic-unknown, type contradiction and absent operator are separate statuses.

Maintain a price ledger for each new whole value, part meaning, finite production, overload branch, default, exception, alias, bridge, attachment template, initial participant and scope/reset/import convention. List inherited C0 assignments separately; inheritance does not make them confirmed/free semantic evidence. Derived whole entries may have zero additional whole-value charge only when fully determined by already priced parts/rules; a residual must be charged. Report count vector and dependencies, not an unsupported model-compression claim.

Provide one annotation row per conserved source group, including unknown/blocked rows. Every consuming step lists rule/version, lexical entry, exact ordered parts if used, role (mention/predicate/assertion/goal/action/reference), input IDs/types, preconditions, before state, output/event/assertion IDs, register delta and after state. A deferred operation must have opening and exact discharge/closure steps. Checkpoints summarize existing steps; they cannot silently inject results, allocations, actions or measurements.

Before author sees f75v.43–49 or f104v.22–26 bodies, freeze joint f83 discovery dictionary/rules/types/initial conditions/defaults/prices and full transfer predictions. For each additional unit name what the exact operator requires and how missing-pair alternatives are treated. No post-opening new value, alias, exception, scope or semantic repair is admitted as success of that frozen candidate. A changed draft is a separate exploratory model.

Assess every complete unit separately for ZL3b/IT2a/RF1b, with full retained-group totals and actual first barrier. Preserve all ten original pair rows and differing native boundaries. RF absent exact pair at f75v and IT absent pair at f104v are UNBOUND_FOR_EXACT_OPERATOR, not automatic type contradiction or a repaired alias. A complete alternative-unit interpretation may be reported only if independently derivable under the same frozen model. Isolated local pair fit is not whole-unit success.

Report source bookkeeping, finite dictionary consistency, manual typed derivability, materialized execution/replay and written dependency transfer as separate results. Manual complete annotations are not executable parser/grammar PASS; scripted string/row comparisons are not semantic execution. Even complete internal derivation/transfer is conditional on authored C0 meanings and does not rank meanings or identify a language. Physical/historical efficacy is an attributed claim/program, never an observed effect.

Retain GDT1023 fitted material outcomes, GDT1038 original complete-input failures and GDT1047 host-boundary failures. T776 is local postexposure authoring with fitted scopes/role declarations, not a global grammar. Mandatory paragraph-local right-source aiin fails 4 ZL/3 IT boundary cases. No implicit host, paragraph revision, allomorph or reader repair silently rescues that rule. A genuinely changed finite model must name and price the difference, and cannot claim the old rule passed.

statuses.MANUAL_DERIVATION_COMPLETE_C0: All consumed steps derivable from declared fixed functions/rules and paid premises; manual finite review, not parser completeness.
statuses.MANUAL_DERIVATION_PARTIAL_C0: At least one barrier/missing or underdefined step, with downstream blocked consequences retained.
statuses.MATERIALIZED_EXECUTION_REPLAYED_C0: Only if an actual transition implementation and states are available and independently replayed; not required to invent one for this task.
statuses.WRITTEN_DEPENDENCY_TRANSFER_C0: Complete written producer/resolver/selection/consumer path survives additional-unit application under frozen rules; conditional semantics only.
statuses.NO_CAPACITY: Unknown words/types, missing written operands/consumer, unresolved ambiguity, unavailable input or externally scoped reader prevent required test.
statuses.CONTRADICTION_OF_FIXED_MODEL: Available explicit input violates a frozen precondition/type/consistency rule; identify exact first failing step.
statuses.UNBOUND_FOR_EXACT_OPERATOR: Exact nominated pair absent in an alternate; neither success nor automatic contradiction.
statuses.FULL_GRAMMAR_PASS: Not warranted by complete manual rows, a whole-state story or a source/accounting validator. No claim of an identified universal grammar is authorized.
statuses.MEANINGS_SELECTED: Not established by any internal bookkeeping/typed transfer outcome.

Manual checkpoints did not establish executable state transitions or an additional observed readout.
